messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: avoid using req("glm_int" %in% names(input))
parts:
Is there a way to check if an input is defined (i.e., contained in names(input)) even if it has value NULL? In other words, is there a way to determine if an input is (1) undefined or (2) defined but with value NULL?

req("glm_int" %in% names(input)) does the job but now there is a dependency on every input which is, of course, undesirable
